//: Test262 cases excluded from conformance262.mjs's headline, beyond features.json's
`inapplicable` class (which is read directly and must not be copied here).
Each entry: { kind: "path" | "feature", match, reason, authority }. A `path`
matches a file or a directory prefix. Excluded cases are still RUN: the exclusion
only moves them out of the headline's denominator, and the report prints how many
each entry covers and how many of those now pass (FIXED?).
An entry naming a path the suite does not have fails the run. Adding one needs an
authority -- a docs/ section that makes it a non-goal -- not a count that looks bad.
docs/eval.md is a possible design, not a non-goal, so eval-code is not excluded.
